metadata.title: Next.js Boilerplate
metadata.description: REST, JWT auth, i18n, Biome va lightweight animatsiyalar bilan ishlab chiqarishga tayyor Next.js starter.

home.title: Tez, xavfsiz va ko‘p tilli ilova yarating.
home.subtitle: REST API, JWT-ready auth, i18n, Biome, xavfsiz sozlamalar va lightweight UI animatsiyalar bilan zamonaviy Next.js boilerplate.
home.authDescription: HTTP-only token cookie, refresh flow hook, server REST client va client auth state istalgan backendga ulashga tayyor.
home.restDescription: Timeout, error normalization, locale header, cache control va bearer token support bilan typed fetch wrapper.
home.i18nDescription: English, Uzbek va Russian uchun locale routing, mos tarjimalar, metadata va language switcher.
home.securityDescription: Yangilangan paketlar, strict TypeScript, Biome checks, secure headers, GraphQL/Apollo yo‘q va safe defaults.
home.performanceDescription: Server components, kichik client islands, strict env validation, request timeouts va package import optimization.
home.healthCardDescription: Deploy smoke test uchun shu routedan foydalaning.
home.animationDescription: Motion orqali silliq UI micro-interactionlar, kichik client-side overhead bilan.

auth.loginHint: Bu forma ishlashi uchun backenddagi POST /auth/login endpointini ulang.
auth.loginError: Kirish muvaffaqiyatsiz. API URL va credentiallarni tekshiring.

common.errorDescription: Sahifani yangilang yoki keyinroq qayta urinib ko‘ring.
